rule_spec.rationale: a tier indicator is admitted to a training fold only when at least 10 distinct GAME CLUSTERS in that fold carry the tier and the indicator has non-degenerate variance. The cluster floor mirrors feature_gate's own refusal to assess rank below 10 complete rows, lifted from rows to clusters because both team-rows of a game share one projection.
rule_spec.applied_to: candidate AND null, identically, once per fold
